import awkward as ak
from pocket_coffea.lib.cuts import BaseCut
from pocket_coffea.lib.categorization import MultiCut, CartesianCut

# Jet multiplicity binning: exactly 4, exactly 5, at least 6 jets
jet_exactly_4 = BaseCut(
    name="j4",
    function=lambda events: ak.num(events.JetGood) == 4
)

jet_exactly_5 = BaseCut(
    name="j5",
    function=lambda events: ak.num(events.JetGood) == 5
)

jet_at_least_6 = BaseCut(
    name="j6",
    function=lambda events: ak.num(events.JetGood) >= 6
)

jet_multiplicity_binning = MultiCut(
    name="jet_multiplicity",
    cuts=[jet_exactly_4, jet_exactly_5, jet_at_least_6]
)

# B-tag multiplicity binning: exactly 2, at least 3 b-jets
btag_exactly_2 = BaseCut(
    name="b2",
    function=lambda events: ak.num(events.JetGood[events.JetGood.btagDeepFlavB > 0.2783]) == 2
)

btag_at_least_3 = BaseCut(
    name="b3",
    function=lambda events: ak.num(events.JetGood[events.JetGood.btagDeepFlavB > 0.2783]) >= 3
)

btag_multiplicity_binning = MultiCut(
    name="btag_multiplicity",
    cuts=[btag_exactly_2, btag_at_least_3]
)

# Cartesian product: all combinations of jet and b-tag multiplicities
analysis_categories = CartesianCut(
    name="analysis_categories",
    cuts=[jet_multiplicity_binning, btag_multiplicity_binning]
)
